title: The tiny weakness that broke Baldur in God of War
subject: baldur
description:
Did you catch the mistletoe on Atreus's quiver? 👇

The one thing Freya's spell missed, and the Norse myth it comes from. Spoilers for God of War (2018).

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Santa Monica Studio or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Baldur's immortality ended with an arrowhead tied to a boy's quiver.
Freya's spell had one gap. Mistletoe could still hurt him.
The dwarf Sindri had made mistletoe arrows for Atreus, and Freya took them away.
Atreus kept one tip anyway, as the clasp on his quiver strap.
In their final fight, that tip cut Baldur's hand, and the spell broke.
In the Norse myths, Baldr also dies by mistletoe, thrown by his blind brother Hodr and guided by Loki.
At the end of the game, Atreus learns the name his mother gave him. It's Loki.
